data.name: Feeling Blu
data.detailed_description:
Um. Hi everyone. It's Blu.

I... I moved to the city a few months ago... and it's been a little lonelier than I thought.

To make ends meet, I started streaming. I mostly play hidden object games... they feel cozy, and people seem to like watching me try to find things.

[holds up pink bunny] This is Kone. He's been with me since I was little. He sits on the shelf near my desk for good luck.

I thought it might be... nice... to play these games with all of you. It's comforting to have the company.

I'm not always the best at finding things, so... when I'm stuck on camera, maybe you could help me? A little nudge in the right direction would mean a lot.

We'd be solving the puzzles together. It would be... really nice to not be looking alone.

I'm going to try it on stream soon.

Maybe... we could play together?

  • Blu

Features

  • Play Along During My Streams. I play a few different hidden object games. They're quiet and a little slow— the kind you can relax to. Each one has its own feeling. I'd tell you more about them, but... I think it's better if you just see them and interact with me on stream.

  • Help Me When I'm Stuck: I get lost sometimes. If you're watching and I'm stuck on something, you can send a small hint my way. Nothing big—just a little nudge. I might get flustered, but... it helps. Really.

  • Send Small Gifts (If You Want). Sometimes viewers send me things. A flower. A warm drink. A tiny plush. I put them somewhere I can see them while I stream. It's a nice reminder that someone's there supporting me. It feels like... warmth. Like someone's cheering for me. I don't know if it means anything to anyone else. But it means something to me. Like I feel a little closer.

  • Watch My Life Unfold. I've been keeping a little blog. Nothing fancy where it's just thoughts about my day, photos of Kone, maybe a peek at what I'm reading or what the weather looks like outside my window. I'm still figuring out how to share it, but... if you're someone who wants to know more about me, it might be a nice place to visit. Just quiet moments.

  • Where Does The Story Go? I wonder where I'd be headed to from time to time. Maybe you have a better idea viewer? There's different endings that I pictured for myself but I haven't really had a clue of which one's the best.

  • Original Music. I play a little melodica sometimes. I also listen to some great one of a kind music too while I'm streaming.

  • Did You Find That Secret? Sometimes, there's a carrot under every fluff... and sometimes the cake is not a lie. Do you like sweets too?

  • For Quiet Evenings. This isn't a loud game. It's for headphones and tea and a blanket. There's no rush. You can watch as long as you want.

No pressure, though. Only if you want to.

  • Blu

data.short_description: Watch a shy streamer named Blu and play along with her hidden object games, build your wholesome relationship through quiet moments, make cozy memories and help her find the courage to let someone in… ( ◡‿◡ *)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2nd Generation (circa 2010)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 screen resolution

content_descriptors.notes:
Feeling Blu is a psychological horror experience that explores mature and deeply unsettling themes. Player discretion is strongly advised.

While the game contains no graphic violence or on‑screen sexual content, players will encounter:
- A slow‑burn, psychological descent into dread and paranoia.
- Themes of parasocial relationships, emotional dependency, obsession, and isolation.
- An atmosphere of surveillance and the erosion of personal boundaries.
- Implied Suicide and self‑harm
- implied non‑explicit self‑pleasure
- Off‑screen alcohol and prescription‑medication misuse
- Simulated live‑chat text that may include mild profanity and fleeting sexual innuendo.

This is not a game for children or for those sensitive to themes of psychological manipulation, invasion of privacy, gaslighting, suicide, self‑harm, or substance misuse.
